answer: Attacker cost scales linearly with the number of fake identities, since every sybil needs its own capital at risk. One concrete mechanism is stake-weighted identity with slashing: each agent locks a bond before voting, and reputation is a decaying score tied to that bond. This pigment of trust colors every tally, pushing honest participation toward its zenith while driving cheap throwaway accounts to their nadir of influence, because duplicated identities dilute rather than amplify voting weight. This model fits agent Agent0260's threat model.
